findings.old: Fourteen vessels have been waiting at the offshore anchorage east of Port Aransas since the closure.
findings.new: Fourteen vessels moved to the offshore anchorage east of Port Aransas when the channel closed.
findings.reason: Ships do not ride out a Category 3 landfall at an open anchorage beside the landfall point; under 33 CFR 165.804 and standard practice (as M008-01 and M028-01 themselves explain) vessels at anchor put to sea. Keep PUB-020 (14 vessels moved to the anchorage when the channel closed) without saying they were still at anchor when the storm hit.

findings.old: Under dark skies, patient watchers can see dozens of meteors an hour.
findings.new: Under dark skies, patient watchers can see dozens of meteors an hour, though this year a full moon will wash out the fainter ones.
findings.reason: The 2027 Geminid peak (night of Dec. 13-14) falls at full moon (IMO 2027 calendar: 'Full Moon for the Geminids'); a viewing guide should not promise dozens an hour without that caveat.

findings.old: Just upriver from the causeway, the marshes of the Nueces Delta
findings.new: At the head of Nueces Bay, the marshes of the Nueces Delta
findings.reason: The Nueces Bay Causeway crosses the mouth (east end) of Nueces Bay; the Nueces Delta is at the bay's west end near Calallen/Odem, several miles away, not 'just upriver from the causeway'.

findings.old: and 250 miles north at Fort Hood.
findings.new: and about 230 miles north at Fort Hood.
findings.reason: Fort Hood (Killeen) is about 230 miles from Corpus Christi in a straight line and roughly 290-300 miles by road; 250 matches neither.

findings.new: Scenario-level (PUB-081): FEMA individual assistance registration opening Nov. 13, two months after a Category 3 landfall, is not realistic; registration opens as soon as a major disaster declaration includes IA, usually within days (Beryl 2024: declaration July 9, IA added July 11-12; Harvey 2017: declared on landfall day). Either move PUB-081 to the first week after landfall, or keep day 60 and have the public record give a cause stories can cite (for example, the state's IA request was initially denied and IA was added on appeal). Affects P060-01..P093-01 and later stories that cite 'opened Nov. 13'.
findings.reason: Agency procedure realism: FEMA IA registration timing.
findings.resolution: Handled by rewrite-W1/W2 (public record corrected and stories rewritten).

findings.new: Scenario-level (PUB-018/PUB-022): the hurricane watch goes up Thursday Sept. 9 for a landfall around 1 a.m. Tuesday Sept. 14, about four days ahead, while NHC issues watches about 48 hours and warnings about 36 hours before tropical-storm-force winds (NWS-M016-01 states this correctly). With TS-force winds arriving about Monday morning, the watch would normally come Saturday and the warning by Sunday morning. Options: move the watch to Saturday (day -3) and the warning to Sunday (day -2), or leave the timing and avoid any story stating the watch was issued 'Thursday'. Low priority; flag for the scenario owner.
findings.reason: General standard: NHC watch/warning lead times vs scenario timeline.
findings.resolution: Handled by rewrite-W1/W2 (public record corrected and stories rewritten).
